title: Am I misunderstanding the Simulation settings?
body:
I've caught a slight cold, and would like to adjust my simulation settings accordingly.
Normally, I'm rather happy with the (default, I think) settings of 12g carbs per unit, and 40 mg/dl per unit.
If I move the slider to 120% the insulin sensitivity would drop accordingly, to 33 mg/dl per unit, but at the same time, the carbs per unit would go up to 14.4. The product of both values stays constant. This looks wrong to me - as the glucose rise per carb (i.e., the ratio of both values, not their product) is supposed to stay the same. There's certainly something I must be misunderstanding? Latest xDrip nightly...
